car.tip: Carpool or take the metro for regular trips

flight.tip: Choose rail where a train route exists

geyser.tip: Keep hot showers short and heat water only when needed

chicken_meal.tip: Try one meat-free meal a day

mutton_meal.tip: Keep red meat for rare occasions

beef_meal.tip: Keep red meat for rare occasions

food_waste_100g.tip: Take half portions first; compost scraps

gaming.tip: Cap session length and switch the console off fully

clothing_new.tip: Try second-hand or swap with friends

phone_new.tip: Repair or keep your phone another year

room_heater.tip: Wear a layer and heat only the room you are in

iron.tip: Iron a few clothes in one go, or skip ironing casual wear

pizza.tip: Choose a veg topping and share a large one

fish_meal.tip: Mix in more plant-based meals in the week

shoes_new.tip: Repair the sole or buy one good pair that lasts

gadget_small.tip: Buy refurbished or keep your gadget longer

paper_cup.tip: Carry your own cup or ask for a kulhad

takeaway_container.tip: Eat in, or carry a steel tiffin for takeaway

plastic_bag.tip: Keep a cloth bag in your backpack

auto.tip: Share the auto or take the metro or bus for regular trips

bike.tip: Switch to an electric scooter or public transport for daily trips

carpool.tip: Take the metro or bus when the route allows

ev_car.tip: Even electric cars beat a petrol car, but the metro beats both

paneer_meal.tip: Paneer is dairy-heavy; dal and sabzi are lighter on the planet

veg_burger.tip: Home-style meals usually beat packaged fast food

hot_shower.tip: A bucket bath uses less hot water than a long shower

electricity_kwh.tip: Switch off at the plug, use the AC at 26 °C and pick 5-star appliances
